messages.en:
{07 15 00}Hide-and-seek?!{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 01 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Remember?!
I went to hide! But you
never went looking for me!
{07 16 00}If you didn't want to play,
you should have just said
so{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 06 00}I've been waiting for you
this whole time,{01 00 00 0a 00}
{04 02 00}!{03 03 00 02}
messages.et:
{07 15 00}Peitust?!{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 01 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Mäletad?!
Ma läksin peitu! Aga sa ei
tulnud mind kunagi otsima!
{07 16 00}Kui sa ei tahtnud mängida,
oleksid võinud lihtsalt
öelda{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 06 00}Ma ootasin sind kogu
selle aja,{01 00 00 0a 00}
{04 02 00}!{03 03 00 02}

messages.en:
{07 04 00}Uh,{07 00 00} I kept waiting and
waiting, but you never came
to find me.
{07 16 00}I finally went home 'cause I
was dying of hunger.

{07 1b 00}That game is no fun when
the seeker is terrible at
seeking,{01 00 00 0a 00} {04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 04 00}Ee,{07 00 00} ma ootasin ja
ootasin, aga sa ei tulnud
kunagi mind otsima.
{07 16 00}Lõpuks läksin koju, sest
olin näljast suremas.

{07 1b 00}See mäng pole lõbus, kui
otsija on otsimises
kohutav,{01 00 00 0a 00} {04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 0b 00}Hello?! Hide-and-seek?!{01 00 00 14 00} {07 14 00}Oh{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}
That means I win!

{07 00 00}I thought it was just a
rumor,{07 1b 00} but you really are
terrible,{01 00 00 05 00} {04 02 00}.
{07 16 00}I've never met anyone who
was sooo bad at hide-and-
seek!
messages.et:
{07 0b 00}Halloo?! Peitust?!{01 00 00 14 00} {07 14 00}Oh{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}
See tähendab, et võidan!

{07 00 00}Arvasin, et see on lihtsalt
kuulujutt,{07 1b 00} aga sa oled
tõesti kohutav,{01 00 00 05 00} {04 02 00}.
{07 16 00}Pole kunagi kohanud kedagi,
kes oleks nii halb
peitusemängija!
